component.name: My Linux T248R Panel
component.summary: Set up and tune the Thrustmaster T248R racing wheel

description.p: My Linux T248R Panel gets a Thrustmaster T248R racing wheel working on Linux, force feedback included, and then lets you test and tune it.

ul.li: Installs the hid-tmff2 force feedback driver through DKMS, so it keeps working after kernel updates
Switches the wheel from PlayStation mode to PC mode for you
Shows steering, pedals, buttons, the D-pad and the encoders live
Sets rotation range, strength, spring, damper and friction
Tests the TH8A and TH8S shifters over USB

description.p: Setting up the driver asks for your password once. This app is not made by or affiliated with Thrustmaster.
